grade_and_subject.standards_system_name: B.E.S.T. Standards (Benchmarks for Excellent Student Thinking)

domains.domain_name: Learning and Applying Foundational Reading Skills

standards.text: Use knowledge of grade-appropriate phonics and word-analysis skills to decode words. a. Apply knowledge of all letter-sound correspondences, syllabication patterns, and morphology to read and write unfamiliar single-syllable and multisyllabic words in and out of context.
standards.label: A

standards.text: Read grade-level texts with accuracy, automaticity, and appropriate prosody or expression.
standards.label: A

standards.text: Analyze how setting, events, conflict, and characterization contribute to the plot in a literary text.
standards.label: A

standards.text: Explain the development of stated or implied theme(s) throughout a literary text.
standards.label: A

standards.text: Describe how an author develops a character’s perspective in a literary text.
standards.label: A

standards.text: Explain how figurative language and other poetic elements work together in a poem.
standards.label: A

standards.text: Explain how text structures and/or features contribute to the overall meaning of texts.
standards.label: A

standards.text: Explain how relevant details support the central idea(s), implied or explicit.
standards.label: A

standards.text: Analyze an author’s purpose and/or perspective in an informational text.
standards.label: A

standards.text: Track the development of an argument, identifying the specific claim(s), evidence, and reasoning.
standards.label: A

standards.text: Analyze how figurative language contributes to meaning in text(s).
standards.label: A

standards.text: Summarize a text to enhance comprehension. a. Include plot and theme for a literary text. b. Include the central idea and relevant details for an informational text.
standards.label: A

standards.text: Compare and contrast primary and secondary sources related to the same topic.
standards.label: A

standards.text: Demonstrate fluent and legible cursive writing skills.
standards.label: A

standards.text: Write personal or fictional narratives using a logical sequence of events and demonstrating an effective use of techniques such as dialogue, description, and transitional words and phrases.
standards.label: A

standards.text: Write to make a claim supporting a perspective with logical reasons, relevant evidence from sources, elaboration, and an organizational structure with varied transitions.
standards.label: A

standards.text: Write expository texts about a topic using multiple sources and including an organizational structure, relevant elaboration, and varied transitions.
standards.label: A

standards.text: Improve writing by planning, revising, and editing, with guidance and support from adults and feedback from peers.
standards.label: A

standards.text: Present information orally, in a logical sequence, using nonverbal cues, appropriate volume, clear pronunciation, and appropriate pacing.
standards.label: A

standards.text: Follow the rules of standard English grammar, punctuation, capitalization, and spelling appropriate to grade level.
standards.label: A

standards.text: Conduct research to answer a question, organizing information about the topic and using multiple reliable and valid sources.
standards.label: A

standards.text: Arrange multimedia elements to create emphasis and/or clarity in oral or written tasks.
standards.label: A

standards.text: Use digital writing tools individually or collaboratively to plan, draft, and revise writing.
standards.label: A

standards.text: Use grade-level academic vocabulary appropriately in speaking and writing.
standards.label: A

standards.text: Apply knowledge of Greek and Latin roots and affixes, recognizing the connection between affixes and parts of speech, to determine the meaning of unfamiliar words in grade-level content.
standards.label: A

standards.text: Use context clues, figurative language, word relationships, reference materials, and/or background knowledge to determine the meaning of multiple-meaning and unknown words and phrases, appropriate to grade level.
standards.label: A

key_learning_outcomes.label: C
items: Students apply phonics, syllabication, and morphology to read and write unfamiliar words and read grade-level texts with accuracy, automaticity, and prosody.
Students analyze plot, theme, character perspective, and poetic elements, and explain informational text structure, central ideas, purpose, and arguments.
Students summarize literary and informational texts and compare primary and secondary sources.
Students write narratives, claims, and expository texts in fluent cursive, follow grade-level conventions, and research with multiple reliable sources.
Students present orally, use academic vocabulary, Greek and Latin roots, and context clues, and use digital tools and multimedia in communication.

ELA.5.F.1.1 and ELA.5.F.1.2 are not printed in the grade 5 benchmark list.
